subject: learning/composed-git-hooks
statement: Desk setup and executor rearming must use one Git hook installer: the shared dispatcher preserves the parent-checkout guard and forwards each repository hook, including pre-push verification and commit stamping, from the invoking worktree.
intent: Keep local verification active across executor runs and linked worktrees.
rationale: The previous guard-only core.hooksPath replacement silently displaced pre-push. The shared Go installer records the repository hook source, migrates old installations, preserves custom paths, and rejects recursive dispatch; doctor verifies dispatcher contents and executable modes.
fit_criterion: Real Git tests reject a red-gate push, accept a green-gate push, preserve hook arguments and stdin, and verify rearming, linked worktrees, parent commit rejection, and missing-hook diagnosis.
